verdict.rationale: The evidence shows public lookup tools on the SOS corporations page, a "CCFS Search" and an "Apostille Search". These suggest a founder can check business-record or apostille information from public pages, but neither item documents filing, application, or case status tracking. The DOR portal probe returned only a JavaScript shell and says nothing about status visibility. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that public search shows pending filing or application status, case/request status tracking details, and hands-on or independent corroboration of what the searches return.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages
